Changelog

Each release leads with one change, then a few fixes.

v2.3.142026-11-14

The right side is now a tabbed workspace for several agents and files at once. Scheduled tasks and delegated coding assistants can also run with risk-based review; without an OS sandbox, commands still need confirmation one by one.

  • Opening a sub-agent or a file adds a tab on the right. Several can stay open, each with its live state. Tabs can be reordered, maximized, split, or popped out. A hover card is available, and a text selection can be added to the conversation or asked about in a side chat; more than one side chat can be open.
  • The sub-agent sidebar now matches the main pane.
  • Pinning a conversation keeps it first inside the current project, instead of moving it outside the project.
  • The Dynamic Island notifies once when a task finishes. When the workbench is already on screen, only items that need your action or an alert appear.
  • Third-party CLI models use the same thinking depth as the main conversation. Local assistant sign-in and the "external CLI" entry are gone.
  • Scheduled tasks: with a grant of L3 ("can run commands") or higher and an OS sandbox available, commands go to command review and run once cleared. Only high-risk steps, credential reads, never-allow classes, review rejections, and actions after reading outside content still stop to ask. Without an OS sandbox (including on Windows), L3 does not auto-run commands; they stay on per-command confirmation, while file edits can still happen automatically. "Judge by risk" and foreground "full auto" also will not auto-run commands in that case. "Judge by risk" is checked by default when creating a task; uncheck it to be asked about every command.
  • Delegated coding assistants (such as Codex): finished work is accepted automatically, changes are landed in the working tree, and the result returns to the conversation. Background tasks also follow risk-based review; without an OS sandbox, commands are not auto-approved.
  • Command review sends the full command to the review model. Common secrets, tokens, and the home directory are redacted first, but redaction cannot catch every secret.
  • Recurring tasks return to "waiting for trigger" after each run instead of getting stuck on "awaiting acceptance".
  • Messages to a sub-agent can only go to a discovered child of the current tab; the main thread and unregistered ids are rejected.

Details

  • Workspace authorization errors in the preview stay visible instead of flashing by.
  • Diff drafts survive switching preview tabs, and saves check the revision first so they do not overwrite outside changes.
  • The unused "Agents in this session" item is gone from the + menu; the Agents list in session details remains.

v2.3.132026-11-13

When a decision is needed, a question card appears above the composer; you can also choose a thinking depth for each model.

  • Nomi, Claude Code, Codex and ACP questions are answered on this card: lettered options, free text, multi-select or skip. Stop, emergency stop, closing the session, or a timeout ends the question.
  • Thinking depth lives in the model chip and only appears for models that can think. The default is the second tier in that model's own list.
  • Context is compacted at each model's standard window, defaulting to 256K. Unrecognized models also use 256K, no longer 128K.
  • Coding-assistant detection no longer stays on “Checking…”: local install state is shown as soon as the probe finishes, and latest versions refresh in the background (#350).

Fixes

  • Conversation titles are generated as soon as you send, and the sidebar and preview show running state.
  • Diff draft saves check the revision first so they do not overwrite outside changes. A failed save keeps the draft.
  • Opening Computer Use settings on Windows no longer pops command consoles repeatedly.

v2.3.122026-11-12

The workbench is no longer split into Chat and Workshop; coding-agent UI stays visible once those tools are installed.

  • The sidebar top row is a full-width New chat button; only Settings remains at the bottom left. Knowledge and Extensions still open from the composer menu or shortcuts.
  • Gemini no longer offers Google account sign-in. Upgrading deletes Gemini accounts and credentials saved in Nomi; it does not change ~/.gemini in your terminal.
  • Computer Use screenshots and visual targeting skip blocked apps; the emergency stop also cancels a turn that has already been running.
  • Unsaved edits in a Diff preview tab are kept when you switch tabs, and closing the tab asks first. The first “New task” from the command palette opens the create form.

Fixes

  • “Use the terminal proxy” now lives only under Settings → Coding agents → General.
  • Icon buttons no longer show native tooltips; their names come from accessibility labels.
  • The in-app word 智能体 is now Agents.

v2.3.112026-11-11

Diffs of changed files open as tabs next to the files you have open.

  • Click a file under Changes in the right rail to open its diff tab, one per file.
  • Drag the edge of the chat sidebar to resize it; double-click resets.
  • Deleting a coding-agent session stops its process first, then permanently removes the record.

Fixes

  • After deleting a task, the list, board and counts refresh right away.
  • On macOS the desktop character no longer takes focus from the chat window.
  • A Claude Code subagent's session no longer replaces the main one.

v2.3.102026-11-11

Nomi and your coding agents can now operate apps on your computer.

  • Install the executor in Settings → Computer Use (agent-desktop, open source from Vercel Labs, Apache-2.0) and grant access, and Nomi can read the UI, click, fill in forms and press shortcuts.
  • Allow once and the rest of that conversation runs on its own; payments, sending and deleting still ask.
  • Claude Code and Codex can open the app and click through it after changing code; stop it any time.
  • Onboarding is three steps and lands on the board.

Fixes

  • Commands can “Always run in this chat”.
  • File diffs are syntax-highlighted.
  • After a coding agent’s first turn fails, the next turn resumes the same session.
  • Task budget interception is gone, so auto-continue no longer stops halfway.

v2.3.92026-11-10

Make your own themes, and view and edit files right in the chat window.

  • “My themes”: pick four colors and get a full theme with contrast fixes.
  • The file side panel previews and edits documents and source code.
  • Choose how much detail each chat shows: compact, thinking, or detailed.

Fixes

  • Changing a project’s folders mid-run takes effect on the next turn (#309).
  • The Agent board can pause Nomi’s background runs.

Older releases are on GitHub Releases.
